    import pyspark.sql.functions as F
    df = dfc.select(list(dfc.keys())[0]).toDF()
    #add load date field
    df = df.withColumn("loaddt", F.substring(F.input_file_name(),-19,10))
    #add load timestamp
    df = df.withColumn("loadts", F.substring(F.input_file_name(),-19,19))
    #add record counter
    df = df.withColumn("counter", F.monotonically_increasing_id())
    sydf = DynamicFrame.fromDF(df,glueContext, "sydf")
    return(DynamicFrameCollection({"CustomTransform": sydf}, glueContext))
